verdict.rationale: Ardent is a Postgres branching platform, so a built-in performance insights view is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no slow-query view, no index recommendations, and no performance metrics dashboard. The closest item is a regression-testing workflow where users manually try a new index on a branch to see whether it speeds up real queries (ardent-docs-22). That is self-run validation, not a built-in insights view with recommendations, so it is not credited.
